scope: Curated numeric evidence, no source charts/checkpoints/local paths. Reported results are exploratory, not a fresh rerun or independently verified quality benchmark.

summary.limitation: Teacher-forced conditional endpoint feasibility on selected LN-rich charts; not free-generation quality.

resume.discarded_updates: 276–297 were recomputed; their original timings were truncated by normal checkpoint journal recovery and are excluded from the retained-update throughput comparison. The deadline also interrupted partial update298.
resume.cost_limit: Retained-step ratio is not total wall-time throughput; original invocation hit7200s and resume invocation includes recovery and remaining validation. Concurrent diagnostics and generation confound clean timing.

paired_clock_recurrence.definition: Adjacent attacks are within each column; rolling spans may overlap and include other-column actions. Thresholds are descriptive locators, not universal playability or Foundation cutoffs.

clock100_lineage_coverage.method: Union of half-open source_sha256/start/stop target-row intervals from retained training journals; prefixes do not count as supervised exposure. Checkpoint ancestry ends at clock100; endpoint-only fitting does not update the backbone.
